name: Fulply Chatbot
author: fulply

sections.description:
Fulply is an AI chatbot for WordPress websites. It reads your pages and posts, learns your business’s own content, and answers visitor questions instantly — day or night, in any language.

Key features

  • Learns from your site — Fulply imports your pages and posts automatically; no manual training needed.
  • Answers only from your content — when the chatbot doesn’t know something, it says so and offers a contact form instead of guessing.
  • Captures leads — collects visitor name, email, and phone mid-conversation, with instant notifications.
  • Multilingual — replies in the visitor’s language, whatever language your site is written in.
  • No performance impact — the widget loads as a single independent script; it doesn’t touch your WordPress database or add PHP overhead.
  • Free to start — a free plan is available, no credit card required.

This plugin only adds the Fulply widget loader to your site using the Chatbot ID you provide. You create and manage the chatbot itself at fulply.com.

Third-party service

This plugin connects your site to Fulply (fulply.com), a hosted chatbot service. Once installed, it loads a script from fulply.com that displays the chat widget; conversations between your visitors and the chatbot are processed and stored on Fulply’s servers, not in your WordPress database. See Fulply’s Terms of Service and Privacy Policy.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate the plugin.
  2. Create a free chatbot at fulply.com and copy its Chatbot ID from the Widget settings page.
  3. In WordPress, go to Settings > Fulply Chatbot and paste the Chatbot ID.
  4. Save Changes — the widget appears on your site immediately.
sections.faq:
Do I need a Fulply account?

Yes. Create a free account at fulply.com to set up your chatbot’s content and get a Chatbot ID.

Does this plugin slow down my site?

No. It loads a single deferred script; conversations happen in Fulply’s own hosted widget, not in your WordPress database.

Is there a free plan?

Yes, Fulply has a free plan with no credit card required.
